title: Informal Reductions
subtitle: Gonna, Wanna, Kinda & More
description: Native speakers constantly reduce and blend words in casual speech. Understanding and using these reductions will make you sound far more natural in everyday conversation.
tip: These reductions only appear in casual, informal speech — never in formal presentations or careful pronunciation — so use them with friends and in relaxed settings.
phrases: I'm gonna go to the store — you wanna come with me?
She's kinda tired but she's gotta finish the whole thing.
I dunno what he was thinking when he said that.
We're gonna hafta leave early if we wanna catch the train.
Lemme know if you need anything — I've lotsa time today.
He's sorta okay with it but he's still kinda upset.
Gimme a second — I'm gonna look it up right now.
You dunno what you wanna do, but you gotta decide soon.
